title: RANDOM IS HARD TO BEAT: ACTIVE SELECTION IN ONLINE DPO WITH MODERN LLMS
reasoning: The paper is a technical empirical study of active learning selection strategies for online Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). While it evaluates models on 'harmlessness' using the Anthropic HH-RLHF dataset, this is treated as a standard safety/alignment performance metric rather than an investigation into moral reasoning, religious values, or specific ethical frameworks.
